result.brief: 提出轻量文本辅助机器人视频动作模型，将未来预测分解为物体中心粒子运动与稠密外观潜空间，用冻结SAM3-DLP编解码与时空Transformer实现粒子状态前推。
result.reason: Text-assisted robot video action model factorizes prediction into object-centric particle motion and appearance latents; contributes a video prediction representation and world-model interface, though application-oriented.
